title: Schraut leads Royalton at Pierz Invite - NewsBreak
text:
By Jeffrey Hage ,
7 hours ago
Schraut leads Royalton at Pierz Invite
Zach Schraut shot a 74 to lead Royalton to a fifth-place team finish at the Pierz Invite.
Schraut tied for fourth individually, finishing three shots behind co-medalists Josh Hoff of Albany and Evan Swenson of Brainerd, who each carded 71s. Schraut was steady throughout the round, shooting 37 on both the front and back nine.
Brainerd won the team title with a 305. Pierz Black and Albany tied for second with 313s, followed by Milaca at 334 and Royalton at 336. Pierz Red finished sixth with a 344, Mora was seventh at 352 and Pierz White was eighth at 420.
Royalton had two golfers finish in the top 10. Lucas Champa tied for ninth with an 80, shooting 38 on the front nine and 42 on the back.
Charles Hanson tied for 25th with an 88, Sebastian Mitzel placed 32nd with a 94, Wyatt Plumski placed 40th with a 100 and Mathew Hollenbeck placed 43rd with a 102.
